Libraries:

```{r}
library(SpatialBSS)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(JADE)
library(moments)
```

Load the 3-variate spatial dataset.

```{r}
data <- st_read("data/processed/londonCRE.gpkg", quiet=TRUE)
```

We build the spatial kernel functions which we will utilize also for spJADE.

```{r}
#we project to meters instead of longitude/latitude
cre <- st_transform(data, crs = 27700)
coords <- st_coordinates(cre)
bandwidths <- c(0, 1000, 
                1000, 3850, 
                3850, 8450, 
                8450, 22000)
kernel_list <- spatial_kernel_matrix(coords, 
                                     kernel_type = "ring",
                                     kernel_parameters=bandwidths)
```

Prepare for sbss:

```{r}
X <- data %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(Value, Volatility, Liquidity) %>%
  as.matrix()

n <- nrow(X)
kernel_list <- c(list(diag(1, n, n)), kernel_list)
Sf_list <- lapply(kernel_list_f0, function(kmat) {
  sum(kmat) / nrow(kmat)
})
```

We implemented normalization and check if it affects the frjd efficiency.

```{r}
sbss_res <- sbss(x=X, kernel_list=kernel_list)
print(sbss_res$w)
```

Now we run the spJADE method:

```{r}
source("../src/spICA.R")
#now rerun the experiments but without frobenius normalization
spjade <- function(x, kernel_list, Sf_list, eps = 1e-06, maxiter = 100) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  p <- ncol(x)
  K <- length(kernel_list)
  
  x_mu <- colMeans(x)
  
  whitening <- whiten_data(x)
  Y <- whitening$Y
  W0 <- whitening$W0
  
  lcovs <- SpatialBSS::local_covariance_matrix(
    x = Y,
    kernel_list = kernel_list,
    lcov = "lcov"
  )
  
  C_array <- array(0, dim = c(p, p, p * p * K))
  idx <- 1
  for (i in 1:K) {
    kmat <- kernel_list[[i]]
    lcov <- lcovs[[i]]
    Sf <- Sf_list[[i]]
    
    for (k in 1:p) {
      for (l in 1:p) {
        C_array[, , idx] <- compute_ckl(k, l, kmat, lcov, Y, Sf)
        idx <- idx + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  # for (i in 1:K) {
  #   slice_indices <- ((i - 1) * p * p + 1):(i * p * p)
  #   block_norm <- sqrt(sum(C_array[, , slice_indices]^2))
  #   if (block_norm > 1e-10) {
  #     C_array[, , slice_indices] <- C_array[, , slice_indices] / block_norm
  #   }
  # }
  
  jd_res <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(JADE::frjd(C_array, maxiter = maxiter, eps = eps)),
    error = function(e) {
      message("frjd failed: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(jd_res)) {
    stop("Joint diagonalization failed.")
  }
  
  W_est <- crossprod(jd_res$V, W0)
  
  x_centered <- sweep(x, 2, x_mu, "-")
  s <- x_centered %*% t(W_est)
  
  colnames(s) <- paste0("spJADE_", 1:p)
  
  res <- list(
    s = s,
    coords = NULL,
    w = W_est,
    x_mu = x_mu,
    d = jd_res$D,
    C_array = C_array
  )
  
  class(res) <- "sbss"
  
  return(res)
}
```

```{r}
spjade_res <- spjade(

  kernel_list = kernel_list, 
  Sf_list = Sf_list
)
print(spjade_res$w)
```

```{r}
spjade_f0_res <- spjade(

```

Classic JADE:

```{r}
jade_res <- JADE(X)
print(jade_res$W)
```

Store results to dataset:

```{r}
cre$spjade_IC1 <- spjade_res$s[, 1]
cre$spjade_IC2 <- spjade_res$s[, 2]
cre$spjade_IC3 <- spjade_res$s[, 3]

```

We assign components to reorganize them accordingly.

```{r}
cre$jade_IC1 <- jade_res$S[, 1]
cre$jade_IC2 <- jade_res$S[, 3]
cre$jade_IC3 <- jade_res$S[, 2]

cre$spjade_f0_IC1 <- spjade_f0_res$s[, 1]
cre$spjade_f0_IC2 <- spjade_f0_res$s[, 2]
cre$spjade_f0_IC3 <- spjade_f0_res$s[, 3]

cre$sbss_IC1 <- sbss_res$s[, 3]
cre$sbss_IC2 <- sbss_res$s[, 2]
cre$sbss_IC3 <- sbss_res$s[, 1]
```

Create spatial neighbor list for Moran's I.

```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(cre)
knn_obj <- knearneigh(coords, k = 6)
nb_obj <- knn2nb(knn_obj)
W_list <- nb2listw(nb_obj, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
```

```{r}
m_jade1 <- moran.test(as.numeric(cre$jade_IC1), W_list)
m_spjade1 <- moran.test(as.numeric(cre$spjade_IC1), W_list)
m_spjade_f0_1 <- moran.test(as.numeric(cre$spjade_f0_IC1), W_list)
m_sbss1 <- moran.test(as.numeric(cre$sbss_IC1), W_list)


comparison_IC1 <- data.frame(
  Method = c("JADE", "spJADE", "spJADE_f0", "SBSS"),
  Moran_I = c(m_jade1$estimate[1],
              m_spjade1$estimate[1],
              m_spjade_f0_1$estimate[1],
              m_sbss1$estimate[1]
              )
)
comparison_IC1
```

Variograms:

```{r}
vario_jade1   <- variogram(cre$jade_IC1 ~ 1, locations = cre)
vario_spjade1 <- variogram(cre$spjade_IC1 ~ 1, locations = cre)
vario_spjade_f0_1 <- variogram(cre$spjade_f0_IC1 ~ 1, locations = cre)
vario_sbss1 <- variogram(cre$sbss_IC1 ~ 1, locations = cre)

combined_vario1 <- rbind(
  cbind(vario_jade1, method = "JADE"),
  cbind(vario_spjade1, method = "spJADE"),
  cbind(vario_spjade_f0_1, method = "spJADE_f0"),
  cbind(vario_sbss1, method = "SBSS")
)

ggplot(combined_vario1, aes(x = dist, y = gamma, color = method, shape = method)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Spatial Structure Comparison: IC1",
       x = "Distance (meters)",
       y = "Semivariance") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("JADE" = "blue",
                                "spJADE" = "red",
                                "spJADE_f0" = "green",
                                "SBSS"= "violet"))
```

Final table for each component:

```{r}
get_spatial_metrics <- function(vario_obj, method_name) {
  nugget <- vario_obj$gamma[1]
  sill <- max(vario_obj$gamma)
  nugget_sill_ratio <- nugget / sill
  
  effective_range <- vario_obj$dist[which.max(vario_obj$gamma)]
  
  data.frame(
    Method = method_name,
    Nugget = round(nugget, 4),
    Sill = round(sill, 4),
    Ratio = round(nugget_sill_ratio, 4),
    Range_Meters = round(effective_range, 0)
  )
}

calculate_entropy <- function(vec) {
  counts <- table(cut(vec, breaks = 50))
  p <- counts / sum(counts)
  p <- p[p > 0]
  -sum(p * log(p))
}

```

```{r}
table_metrics <- rbind(
  get_spatial_metrics(vario_jade1, "JADE"),
  get_spatial_metrics(vario_spjade1, "spJADE"),
  get_spatial_metrics(vario_spjade_f0_1, "spJADE_f0"),
  get_spatial_metrics(vario_sbss1, "SBSS")
)

table_metrics$Entropy <- c(
  calculate_entropy(jade_res$S[,1]),
  calculate_entropy(spjade_res$s[,1]),
  calculate_entropy(spjade_f0_res$s[,1]),
  calculate_entropy(sbss_res$s[,1])
)

print(table_metrics)
```
